notes.title: Update 2.5 Bug fixes and Improvements.
notes.content:
[i]Greetings Agents![/i]

In this update, We have fixed minor bugs in the PvP game mode and new Maps.  Read the patch notes to learn more!

[h3]Patch Size = 45.7Mb[/h3]


[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fix an issue where Greenhill Isle map PvP mode not working properly.
[*] Improved Shadow Forest's performance.
[*] Overall collision issues have been fixed in Shadow Forest.
[*] Players able to get out of bounds in B12 Assembly Plant this has been fixed.
[*] Ingame setting menu buttons will not be pressable this has been fixed.
[/list]

-RAM Studios.

notes.title: Extraction Valley 2.3 Update is now alive!
notes.content:
[i]In this update, We are bringing you new Turret Items to play PvE and a new Map and Much more.  [/i]

[h1]New Map Greenhill Isle[/h1]
This is how the Forgotten Land looks like before DWB nuke the Isle. Visite before it gets nuked, Agents! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35431461/2eac786ac1bb8038f7db08fe250567e5dc284945.jpg[/img]


[h1]New AI the [b]Behemoth[/b][/h1]
Behemoth was developed by OMAGA Corporation to use in the 1st trifule war. But the war ended before they got a chance to deploy Behemoth OMAGA abandoned the project. Now Titans took over the OMAGA Robotics facility and they reactivated the Behemoth. You can now fight agents him in PvE. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35431461/b19b7eb141e798dfee4edceb30e872fedc8d93b3.png[/img]

[h1]New Utility Items "Turrets"[/h1]
You can now activate Turrets in PvE. Collect ENDEIXS by destroying incoming enemies. And use ENDEXIS to activate Turrets. Turrets level up as it killed enemies and switches firing mods as it levels up. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35431461/e6b702eba2ec1ae2484dc4d5cfc7fa3e5c342e8b.jpg[/img]

[h1]HUD Improvemets[/h1]
You can now see the teammate's health and armor on the HUD.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35431461/7c49d96f7b67e94fd40bc33e8a809e2684876bd2.jpg[/img]


[h3]And some minor Bug fixes and improvements[/h3]

notes.title: Extraction Valley 2.1 Update is now alive!
notes.content:
[h1]Titan Invasion[/h1] New Game Mode
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35431461/350a1cc7cb7efb9ffcee12fd005d69a013a5b13d.png[/img]

Titan Invasion is the new mode that we are introducing to this update. Players also can play this mode solo or Co-Op with friends. Players Objective is to defend the harvester from incoming waves of Titan Robots. More improvements for this game mode is coming soon.

[h1]The Forgotten Land[/h1] New Map
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35431461/d685db3399f053d6566d34624bf4cd2bfea432f9.png[/img]
The Forgotten Land is formally known as Skull Walker Island once a tropical Island with rich wildlife. Used by SOA as a secret base of operation during the 1st and 2nd Wars. After DWB uncovers that SOA been using this island as a base of operation DWB nuke the island with a Trifuel Warhead killing everyone and everything on the island. Now only ashes are what remains on this once a beautiful island. 

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] B12 Assembly Plant postprocessing issue has been fixed.
[*] B12 Assembly Plant lighting issue has been fixed.
[*] Fix an issue where players able to go through walls in Trifule Refinery.
[*] Fix an issue where players fall through the floor in Trifule Refinery.
[*] Overall collision issues have been fixed in Trifule Refinery.
[*] Sometimes players will get stuck in the Shadow Forest map This has been fixed.
[*] Overall collision issues have been fixed in Shadow Forest.
[*] Fix an issue where players spawn on top of each other.
[*] Fix an issue where [b]Arura's Heal Punch ability[/b] particles not showing correctly.
[*] Players able to get out of bounds in B12 Assembly Plant this has been fixed.
[*] Ingame setting menu buttons will not be pressable this has been fixed.
[/list]

If you found any issue report to use here or on Discord

[i]-RAM Studios [/i]

notes.title: Extraction Valley Update Note 2019 August v1.04
notes.content:
Patch Type - Steam Patch 
 Date :- 2019/08/19

Scheduled maintenance, August 19th at 12.00AM 
Expected downtime: 15 minutes

We have fixed so many bugs and also improve a lot of things. You guys have been so much help for us and we will continue to update our game. Make sure you give us your feedback. Read the full patch note below. You can also find a lite version of this patch note in-game.

         
  [h1]- New Features -[/h1]

      [list]
        [*]New Europe server added.[/*]

        [*]In-game text chat added (Press "Enter" in-game) -[/*]
        [list]
          [*]Now you can chat with others In-game this is one of the most requested features you guys been asking from us. [/*]
        [/list]

        [*]New graphics option added (Visual Effects) -[/*]
        [list]
          [*]Now you can turn off Visual effects to improve performance.[/*]
        [/list]

        [*]Low quality lighting mode added -[/*]
        [list]
          [*]Now you can turn off lighting in maps to improve performance press "Backspace" in-game.[/*]
        [/list]
      

      
        [h1]- Sound Effects -[/h1]
        
          
We heard from you! yep, it's a Pune. Sounds play a huge role in a shooting game special on a big map so we improved sounds and hit effects to give you more feedback.

        
      [list]
        [*]Improved weapon sounds -[/*]
        [list]
          [*]We added new sounds to each weapon.[/*]
        [/list]

        [*]Improved gun turrets shooting sounds -[/*]
        [list]
          [*]We added a new sound effect for gun turrets and improve sound quality.[/*]
        [/list]

      [/list]
      

      
        [h1]- Gameplay Improvements -[/h1]
      [list]
        [*]Bullet speed increased for some weapons.[/*]
        [*]Decrease FPP mode weapons reloading time to match up with TPP mode.[/*]
        [*]lobby time decreased. (from 5 minutes to 1 minute)[/*]
        [*]Nitro Boost price increased. (from 200 coins to 600 coins)[/*]
        [list]
          [*]Some players like Nitro Boost and its speed but some don't like it we increased its price so it can't easily obtain. We will keep monitoring how this powerup impacts gameplay.[/*]
        [/list]

      [/list]
      

      
        [h1]- UI & UX improvements and Bug Fixes -[/h1]
      [list]
        [*]Ultrawide screen issue fixed.[/*]
        [*]Minor UX Improvements[/*]
      [/list]
      

      
        [h1]- Map improvements and Bug Fixes -[/h1]
      [list]
        [*]The Town map and island  Map performance improved.[/*]
        [list]
          [*]There were lag spicks in these maps. Give us your feedback if you experience any issue in these maps.[/*]
        [/list]
        [*]Respawn points changes[/*]
        [list]
          [*]Players now spawn from the XRONIN Ships (the spaceship)[/*]
        [/list]
      [/list]
      

      
        [h1]- Bug Fixes -[/h1]
      [list]
        [*]Fixed an issue where Crosshair was visible while ADS in FPP mode.[/*]
        [*]Fixed an issue where lobby time is not decreasing when players left the lobby.[/*]
        [*]Fixed an issue where players can't run while ADS'.[/*]
        [*]Players spawn points and Coin Drops points adjusted in lager maps[/*]
      [/list]
      

      
        [h1]- Removed -[/h1]
      [list]

        [*]Knockdown Feature removed.[/*]

      [/list]
      

      
        [h1]- Known Issues -[/h1]
      [list]
        [*]Mouse sensitive cannot be changed in the main menu.[/*]
        [*]Mouse sensitive automatically changes.[/*]
        [*]Fixed an issue where players can't run while ADS.[/*]
        [*]Unexpected FPS drops. You can fix this visit [url=http://www.ramstudioteam.com/helpcenter/]here[/url] to see how. This is a tempory solution we are looking into it.[/*]
      [/list]
      

      
        [h1]Keep Us Updated[/h1]
        
If you found any other Issues report to us. There some other issues we haven't fixed in this patch but we will soon fix those. Thank you!
